title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Quote tweeting Wojo’s tweet for a dead man
I’m not 100 percent sure I know what you mean but I really like where you’re head’s at
Apparently we couldn’t have said this ourselves without QTing
Oh you know what I forgot to mention to you
